Instructions for Use
Device description: The Vega Cochlear Implant is a cochlear implant. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
The Vega Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. A person with the Vega Cochlear Implant may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Vega Cochlear Implant
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 and 3 Tesla
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Receive Coil Type Any
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg
For 3T MR Scanner: Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg; head averaged SAR of 0.4 W/kg
Scan Duration at 3T: Limit total active scanning to 20 min.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
